pages.text: Controls the weather and the time of day. It needs power and holds 8 million OP. Power comes in on any side, so an I/O crystal or an area crystal can feed it.$(br2)$(l)Weather$() (paid when it changes):$(li)Clear or start rain: 256,000 OP$(li)Thunderstorm: 384,000 OP

$(l)Time$(): skip to sunrise, noon, sunset, moonrise, midnight or moonset, or +24 hours, at 320 OP per tick of time (a full day is about 7.7 million OP). It needs the full cost stored first, eases in and out, and Stop ends it early.$(br2)It only changes the clock; machines and crops do not get extra ticks.

pages.title: The Screen
pages.text: Red corner = can't run now; hover for why and the cost. Results show in the box at the bottom.$(li)$(l)Keep skies clear$(): clears rain by itself$(li)$(l)Owner only$(): owner, team, operators$(li)$(l)Tell everyone$(): chat notice$(li)$(l)Quiet boom$()$(li)$(l)Redstone$(): action a signal starts (Off by default)

pages.title: On a Server
pages.text: Each use starts a cooldown for the whole dimension (60 s by default; operators skip it).$(br2)A comparator reads 15 while it runs, otherwise its charge.$(br2)The recipe uses a $(item)Dragon Egg$() and a Wyvern Core.
